by
  cases Int.emod_two_eq_zero_or_one a with h0 h1;
  constructor;
  · rw [Int.mod_eq_zero] at h0;
    rw [Int.mod_eq_zero] at h1;
    exact (h0 || h1)
  · rcases h0 with (h0 | h1);
    · have : a ^ 2 % 4 = 0 := by
        rw [Int.mod_eq_zero]
        exact (Int.mod_eq_zero (a ^ 2) 4)
      exact this
    · have : a ^ 2 % 4 = 1 := by
        rw [Int.mod_eq_one]
        exact (Int.sq_mod_four_eq_one_of_odd (Odd.mk (Int.eq_zero_iff_even.mp h1)))
      exact this
